title: Planning puts _tools/bl_dispatch.py in the touches of an item whose goal changes what the worker brief says
goal: backlog.py check (or precheck) warns of a committed item whose goal or a goal clause names the worker's brief and whose touches do not name _tools/bl_dispatch.py, where the brief's text lives, so the planner adds it before the start gate

run:
import sys, os, json, tempfile, types, io, contextlib, subprocess
sys.path.insert(0, '_tools')
import bl_base, bl_check, bl_land
d = tempfile.mkdtemp()
subprocess.run(['git', 'init', '-q', d], check=True)
os.makedirs(os.path.join(d, '_tools'))
os.makedirs(os.path.join(d, 'kb', '_self', 'backlog'))
for n in ('bl_plan.py', 'bl_dispatch.py'):
    open(os.path.join(d, '_tools', n), 'w').write('x = 1' + chr(10))
subprocess.run(['git', '-C', d, 'add', '.'], check=True)
def put(it):
    open(os.path.join(d, 'kb', '_self', 'backlog', it['id'] + '.json'), 'w').write(json.dumps(it))
bad = [dict(run=['python3', '-c', 'import sys; sys.exit(1)'])]
put(dict(id='SP-aaaaaaaa', kind='sprint', title='planted sprint', status='planned', goal='planted'))
def story(i, goal, touches):
    put(dict(id=i, kind='story', title='planted ' + i, status='draft', priority='P3', sprint='SP-aaaaaaaa', goal=goal, touches=touches, checks=bad))
story('ST-bbbbbbbb', 'The worker brief names the open items that its sibling holds', ['_tools/bl_plan.py'])
story('ST-cccccccc', 'The worker brief names the open items that its sibling holds', ['_tools/bl_plan.py', '_tools/bl_dispatch.py'])
story('ST-dddddddd', 'The planner prints one more line of text', ['_tools/bl_plan.py'])
bl = bl_base.Backlog(d)
buf = io.StringIO()
with contextlib.redirect_stdout(buf):
    bl_check.cmd_check(bl, types.SimpleNamespace())
    bl_land.cmd_precheck(bl, types.SimpleNamespace(sprint='SP-aaaaaaaa'))
lines = [l for l in buf.getvalue().splitlines() if 'bl_dispatch' in l]
print(lines)
sys.exit(0 if any('ST-bbbbbbbb' in l for l in lines) and not any(x in l for l in lines for x in ('ST-cccccccc', 'ST-dddddddd')) else 1)

notes: Retrospective of SP-g2ssvhi2: ST-5z4e6z4i's clause 6 ('the worker's brief names it') needed _tools/bl_dispatch.py, which its planned touches lacked; the orchestrator widened them before the claim (with _tools/test_land_e2e.py and kb/_self/code.md).
